title: HEATER HOSES
summary: Heater hoses for all models, in the engine compartment: the inlet hose [4] runs from a nipple [6] threaded into the engine (intake side) back to the heater core at the firewall; the return side is hose [8] from a nipple [7] on the water pump, joined to hose [1] near the coolant expansion tank and running back to the heater core. Hoses are held with clamps [2] and [3] at each end and bundled by clips [5] at the clip bracket and near the firewall; the nipples are torqued to 15-25 lb-ft.

fastening.note: Nipple [7] threads into the water pump at the front of the engine (by the fan/pulley); hose [8] slides onto it and is held by clamp [2].

fastening.to: nipple [7] and the joint with hose [1]
fastening.note: Clamps [2] hold hose [8] on nipple [7], hose [8] at its joint with hose [1] beside the expansion tank, a hose fitting at the top of the tank area, and hose [1] at the heater core at the firewall (upper right).
Nipple [6] threads into the engine beside the water pump outlet; inlet hose [4] slides onto it.
Clamps [3] hold inlet hose [4] on nipple [6] at the engine and on the lower heater core pipe at the firewall.
Clips [5] wrap the two hoses together: one at the CLIP BRACKET on the left (hoses [8] and [4]) and one near the firewall (hoses [1] and [4]).
